title: Spyglass: General Availability
summary: We're excited to announce that Spyglass has officially graduated from beta to general availability, providing all users with a powerful and refined tool for discovery.

title: Powerful File Management and Display
summary: We've introduced robust new controls within the editor, allowing you to easily upload files, manage your embedded content, and choose from distinct display options to perfectly present your information.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand new public roadmap, offering complete transparency on our product's journey from recently shipped updates to exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly designed checkboxes that are bigger, easier to drag, and beautifully integrated with the rest of your experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a significantly improved real-time collaboration that makes working with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Seamless Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Users can now easily share, discover, and collaborate on ideas and quests with enhanced visibility for all shared items.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce global language support, enabling more users around the world to connect with Noeko effortlessly in their preferred language.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Join us in shaping the future of Noeko as we open-source its codebase, offering unparalleled control and transparency to our community.

title: Personalized Knowledge Explorer
summary: Discover deeper insights and streamline your workflow with powerful new filtering and sharing options for your personalized knowledge map.

title: Precision Search & Saved Views
summary: Find exactly what you're looking for faster than ever with an enriched search experience that includes advanced filtering, flexible sorting, and the power to save your customized results.

title: Flexible Note Organization
summary: Organize your thoughts more intuitively than ever before with new flexible display options for linked content, transforming how you interact with your notes.

title: Noeko's Public Debut: Self-Host & Premium Plans
summary: Prepare for the highly anticipated public release of Noeko, bringing exciting self-hosting capabilities and a range of new paid plans to elevate your experience.

title: Elevated App Aesthetics: New Themes & Refinements
summary: Get ready for a more personalized and visually appealing experience with our upcoming collection of beautiful new themes and refined existing ones.

title: Smarter Time Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our homepage greetings to always display the accurate time of day, ensuring a seamless and personalized welcome experience.

title: Enhanced List Actions for Effortless Organization
summary: Quickly manage your tagged content by removing items, deleting entries, or viewing details directly from any list, making organization much more efficient.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate insights from a broader spectrum of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, to consolidate and enrich all your valuable information.
